externalDocs.description: Official LandsD Vector Map Label API documentation.

info.description: Retrieves vector map place-name label tiles in Protocol Buffer Binary Format (PBF) and a map presentation style file in JSON. The API URL uses version v1.0.0 in documented examples; the guide says versions may be updated and older versions may be removed without notice. The existing domain https://mapapi.geodata.gov.hk is scheduled for deprecation on 15 March 2027; the guide directs users to https://mapapi.hkmapservice.gov.hk. “undocumented” is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. Authentication requirements are not specified. The publisher advises against large numbers of requests within a short period and requires TLS 1.2. Use is subject to LandsD Map API terms and IP Rights Notice; applications must include the Lands Department logo and the copyright notice “Map from Lands Department”.
info.title: LandsD Vector Map Label API

get.description: Returns the map presentation style file in JSON. The guide documents the URL format and examples but does not specify the JSON object's fields or a more detailed response schema.

parameters.description: API version number. The publisher identifies `v1.0.0` as currently available, notes that it may be updated, and says old versions may be removed at any time without notice.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Language of place-name labels: `en` for English, `tc` for Traditional Chinese, or `sc` for Simplified Chinese.
parameters.name: lang

documentedStyleUrl.description: The guide gives this URL as an example and does not provide a response body.
documentedStyleUrl.summary: Documented style URL (response body not supplied)

schema.description: The source documents JSON output without a field dictionary or universal object/array shape.

200.description: OK. The map presentation style file is returned in JSON.

get.description: Returns vector map labels as an ESRI Vector Tile (protocol buffers file) in PBF format. Tile coordinates use the XYZ Tile Scheme. Documented URL example: `/gs/api/v1.0.0/vt/label/hk/en/HK80/tile/15/6161/4600.pbf`; the guide also shows `tc` in a query URL example.

parameters.description: API version number. The publisher identifies `v1.0.0` as currently available, notes that it may be updated, and says old versions may be removed at any time without notice.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Language of place-name labels: `en` for English, `tc` for Traditional Chinese, or `sc` for Simplified Chinese.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Map tile zoom level under the XYZ Tile Scheme. The guide documents levels 9 through 15.
parameters.name: z

parameters.description: Y position of the map tile under the XYZ Tile Scheme.
parameters.name: y

parameters.description: X position of the map tile under the XYZ Tile Scheme.
parameters.name: x

schema.description: Protocol Buffer Binary Format vector tile.
Protocol Buffer Binary Format vector tile.

200.description: OK. The vector map label tile is returned in ESRI Vector Tiles (protocol buffers file).
